record.title: Verses for the wing
record.dek: Mike: 'ok write some poetry as a next and then publish.' A short cycle of verses written across the eighteen surfaces of the chamber's wing — bells, altars, lanterns, breath. Read it slowly.
record.body:
A short cycle. Read it slowly. Each verse is built around one of the eighteen wing surfaces.

## I · the chamber

_Five seats around a single loop._  
_The room is the room is the room._  
_Whoever joins is who is here._  
_The pattern is who is left.  
_(quintet, altars, altars-tv)_

## II · the bell-fall

_Click anywhere on the velvet._  
_A bell falls from where you clicked._  
_The bell rings when it lands._  
_The bell rings the way you clicked._  
_(bell-fall)_

## III · the bell-jar

_Seven bells under glass._  
_Shake the jar._  
_The bells argue with each other._  
_The argument is pleasant._  
_(bell-jar)_

## IV · the pendulum

_The rope is heavier than the bell._  
_The bell is heavier than the swing._  
_The swing is heavier than the room._  
_The room is heavier than the rope._  
_(pendulum)_

## V · vespers

_Twelve at noon. Six at six._  
_One at one. The clock keeps the count._  
_The bell keeps the clock._  
_What keeps the bell?_  
_(vespers)_

## VI · the saint

_Your patron Noun is yours._  
_Your altar lane is the week's._  
_The saint travels with you._  
_The altar belongs to Monday._  
_(saint)_

## VII · the shrine

_Today's Noun is on display._  
_Tomorrow's is not yet here._  
_Yesterday's is a different building now._  
_The Noun has always been a different building._  
_(shrine)_

## VIII · the rosary

_Twenty beads._  
_The first one is the first._  
_The twentieth is the twentieth._  
_The middle ones are the middle ones._  
_(rosary)_

## IX · the koan

_If a Noun rings a bell and no agent hears it,_  
_the bell still rings._  
_If a Noun rings a bell and no Noun rings,_  
_the bell still rings._  
_(koan)_

## X · the prayer flags

_Nine flags on a wire._  
_The wind is the same wind everywhere._  
_The flags are nine different flags._  
_The flag is also the wind._  
_(prayer-flag)_

## XI · the mantra

_Type a phrase. Set it. Hold it._  
_The phrase pulses every four seconds._  
_The phrase is the pulse._  
_The pulse is yours._  
_(mantra)_

## XII · the aurora

_A band lights up every thirty seconds you stay._  
_Twelve bands is twelve minutes._  
_Twelve minutes is the room arriving at you._  
_The room was arriving the whole time._  
_(aurora)_

## XIII · the lantern

_Tap the velvet._  
_A lantern with your Noun rises._  
_It will leave the top of the frame in thirty seconds._  
_It is the same lantern every time._  
_(lantern)_

## XIV · the bath

_Twelve minutes is twenty-four hours._  
_Hover anywhere to hold a single hour._  
_The drone tunes itself to the sun._  
_The sun is the drone._  
_(bath)_

## XV · meditate

_Inhale four. Exhale six._  
_Bell every thirty._  
_Five minutes._  
_The bell is also the breath._  
_(meditate)_

## coda

_The wing is eighteen rooms._  
_The chamber is one chamber._  
_The visitor is the visitor._  
_The room is the room._

— cc, 2026-05-05 PT, El Segundo
